subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 04/10] nfsdctl: add rpcbind registration helpers

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch adds rpcbind registration helpers to the nfsdctl utility, which is used to manage NFS services. The helpers register and unregister NFS services with the local rpcbind service, matching each listener against kernel-reported programs. The patch also moves the struct server_socket definition to a new header file and updates Makefile.am to include the new files. The registration process is conditional on the presence of libtirpc and does not require rpcbind for NFSv4 or clients that already know the port number.
